mu_name_from: MuMain loads the second classes' bare bodies as MODEL_BODY_HELM + MAX_CLASS + i from Data\\Player\\HelmClass2{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp:121-127), and GetSkinModelIndex hands CLASS_SOULMASTER, CLASS_BLADEKNIGHT and CLASS_MUSEELF skins 7, 8 and 9 (_enum.h:3250-3252, CharacterManager.cpp:240-254): Class201 the Soul Master, 202 the Blade Knight, 203 the Muse Elf.
why_this_one: Sevina's class change (the user, 2026-10-04: 'second class quest where char beccomes second class with new skins'; 'MU's way': the second class's body under any slot left empty). docs/game/class-change-quest.md.
sheet_from: Data/Player/HQlevel_man022.OZJ (256x256), from the Season 17 client (third_party/MuClient_S17_v1.19.74). All five of the Soul Master's parts name it.
cull_from: As HelmClass01's: MU's hair is single-sided fins.
model_from: Season 17's remake of MU's Soul Master body, read out of Data/Player/HelmClass201.bmd in the S17 client: a version-14 file, which MuExtract opens through Webzen's ModulusCryptor (pipeline/MuExtract/MuAssets/Crypto). It replaced MuMain's HelmClass201 on 2026-10-15 at the user's call ("okey lets make new dw and sm then", after seeing the two side by side). Its 51 bones are the first 51 of player.bmd's, by name and order, so it rides our rig and clips as MuMain's did.
part_note: The head, 521 triangles. Bound to 389 on Bip01 Head, 14 on Bip01 Spine1.

uv_overrides.why: The white forelock painted into the face block's top right.
A strand that crosses the bottom of the face block.
The face block, the ear at its right edge; the eyes and brows on it stay skin.
The neck piece left of the face.
The small skin patch below the hair.

uv_overrides_why: S17's head is a few shells that each carry face and hair together, so the islands are hair and these lift the skin out by where it lands on the sheet, first rule winning. Found by sampling the sheet under every face's UV centre (2026-10-15): of 521 faces, the skin rules take 200 that read warm and light, the hair rules keep the painted forelock out of the face, and what is left outside them reads grey, the hair.
material_note: hair for the white mane, skin for the face, ears and neck, as MuMain's head was; the split is uv_overrides, below.
rebind_from: As HelmClass02's: S17's head binds 389 vertices to Bip01 Head and a ring of 14 at the base of the neck to Bip01 Spine1, two joints down, and the head turns a long way from the chest in MU's poses (56 degrees in action 5), so a rigidly bound ring is wrung by all of it. Taken onto the head, the fix the knights' heads carry (the user, 2026-10-15).
